title: Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.22820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. translated_title: 基于子组重加权与门控正则化的公平性专家混合模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22820v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：深度学习模型往往因训练数据在性别或年龄等敏感属性上的不平衡，导致不同人口统计群体间的性能差异。为解决此问题，现有工作探索了公平表示学习、数据重采样和对抗训练，大致可分为两类方法。单阶段方法通常学习共享表示以实现公平，但难以处理异质子组分布。两阶段方法从最终预测任务中分离学习表示，可能导致公平目标与下游预测不一致。我们识别出路由诱导偏差，即子组不平衡促使门控网络将子组路由到少数专家，并提出端到端的专家混合（MoE）框架来纠正此问题。具体而言，我们应用子组重加权来纠正。
tldr: 提出了一种端到端的MoE框架，通过子组重加权和门控正则化纠正路由诱导偏差，实现公平性。
en_tdlr: Proposed an end-to-end MoE framework that corrects routing-induced bias via subgroup reweighting and gate regularization for fairness.
